title: Sam Darnold out for Seahawks in Week 9 as Drew Lock gets another start vs. Cardinals

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Sam Darnold out for Seahawks in Week 9 as Drew Lock gets another start vs. Cardinals
sources.description: Darnold will sit with a quad injury, while Lock is expected to make his second start of the season despite dealing with an elbow issue.
